program:
PARAMS = {
    "W_in":   (4.0, 1.5, 10.0),    # diff pair W [um]
    "L_in":   (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),
    "W_ld":   (0.84, 0.42, 2.0),   # PMOS mirror-load W [um]
    "L_ld":   (0.2, 0.15, 0.5),
    "W_mir":  (4.0, 2.0, 8.0),     # NMOS reference mirror W [um]
    "L_mir":  (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "r_tail": (0.5, 0.3, 0.65),    # tail / iref
    "r_s2":   (0.5, 0.3, 0.65),    # stage-2 / iref
    "W_invn": (0.6, 0.42, 2.0),
    "W_invp": (1.5, 0.6, 5.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 50e-15)
    vod = spec.get("vod", 0.01)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    i_tail = iref * p["r_tail"]
    i_s2 = iref * p["r_s2"]
    W_cs = p["W_ld"] * (i_s2 / (i_tail / 2))

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["W_mir"], p["L_mir"])
    n.M("MT",  "tail",  "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["W_mir"] * p["r_tail"], p["L_mir"])
    n.M("M1", "d1",   "vinp", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["W_in"], p["L_in"])
    n.M("M2", "out1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["W_in"], p["L_in"])
    n.M("M3", "d1",   "d1",   "vdd",  "vdd", "pfet", p["W_ld"], p["L_ld"])
    n.M("M4", "out1", "d1",   "vdd",  "vdd", "pfet", p["W_ld"], p["L_ld"])
    n.M("M5", "out2", "out1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W_cs, p["L_ld"])
    n.M("M6", "out2", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["W_mir"] * p["r_s2"], p["L_mir"])
    n.M("M7", "vout", "out2", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["W_invn"], 0.15)
    n.M("M8", "vout", "out2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_invp"], 0.15)

    id1 = i_tail / 2
    vs = 0.25
    gm1 = 18 * id1
    gds2 = gm1 / 60
    try:
        o1 = lut.op("n", p["W_in"], p["L_in"], 0.9 - vs, 0.7, vsb=vs)
        sc = id1 / max(o1["Id"], 1e-12)
        gm1 = o1["gm"] * sc
        gds2 = o1["gds"] * sc
    except Exception:
        pass
    gm4 = 10 * id1
    a_p = 8 + 60 * (p["L_ld"] - 0.15) / 0.35
    gds4 = gm4 / a_p
    g1 = gds2 + gds4
    A1 = gm1 / g1
    cox = 8e-15
    # first stage: linear-regime slewing of out1 by gm1*2*vod
    c1 = cox * (W_cs * p["L_ld"] + p["W_ld"] * p["L_ld"]) + 0.3e-15 * (p["W_in"] + p["W_ld"] + W_cs) + 2e-15
    t1 = c1 * 0.3 / max(gm1 * 2 * vod, 1e-9)
    c2 = cox * 0.15 * (p["W_invn"] + p["W_invp"]) + 0.5e-15 * (W_cs + p["W_mir"] * p["r_s2"]) + 2e-15
    t2 = c2 * 0.9 / i_s2
    i_inv = 150e-6 * p["W_invn"]
    t3 = cl * 0.9 / i_inv
    tpd = t1 + t2 + t3
    power = vdd * (iref + i_tail + i_s2) * 1.03
    return n, {"tpd": tpd, "power": power, "polarity_ok": 1,
               "A1": A1, "gain_tot_vod": A1 * 30 * vod}
